howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: The plugin works right after activation. The setting below is only needed for special multi-subdomain setups.
howTo.item2: Administration: user menu bottom left > Your profile > Passkeys card > Register new passkey (confirm password).
howTo.item3: Customers: in the customer account under Your profile > Passkeys section.
howTo.item4: The login page then offers passkey sign-in. Password login always stays available.
howTo.item5: No passkey button? The page must run via HTTPS on a shop domain (APP_URL or a sales channel domain), and the browser must support passkeys. With SSO admin login, administrators cannot manage passkeys; the storefront is unaffected. If the admin login is restricted to SSO only, the passkey admin login is disabled as well.
howTo.item6: Everyone sets up their own passkeys; nobody can add one for other users or customers. Authorised administrators can, however, revoke other accounts' passkeys: Customers > customer > General tab, or Settings > Users & permissions > user, Passkeys card in each. Restricted roles need the Customer passkeys or User passkeys permission (Delete). For users, your own password is requested.
